events.title: Google Calendar launched
events.summary: Google launched Google Calendar on April 13, 2006 — a web calendar with sharing, invitations, and iCal feeds.
events.about: Google Calendar showed AJAX calendars could replace desktop Outlook for many teams — and its API later enabled scheduling bots and SaaS integrations. It was part of Google's 2006 push to put office workflows in the browser.

narrative.whyChosen: Google Calendar brought shared scheduling to the web at scale.
narrative.whyImportant: It proved calendaring APIs and feeds belonged in cloud platforms.
narrative.problemSolved: Teams juggled desktop calendar files without easy web sharing.
